initial_plan.answerability: partly: the data can compare the share of reported crashes with any person injured or killed by time of day, but cannot establish per-trip or per-person risk without travel exposure.
initial_plan.metric: share of police-reported crashes with at least one person injured or killed
initial_plan.denominator: police-reported crashes with an assignable year and time period
initial_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes in the years present in the file; outcome is present when any person was injured or killed
filters: Night is 20:00 through 05:59; day is 06:00 through 19:59
Rows with missing or unusable crash_date, crash_time, or outcome counts cannot be assigned or classified
initial_plan.years: all years represented in crash_date; inspect coverage and partial years during the data check
limitations: A crash-level outcome share is not a per-trip, per-person, or per-mile risk.
The data records police-reported crashes and recorded injury/death counts only.

data_check.coverage_and_rows: 2,269,187 dated crashes occur in 2012-2026. 2012 is partial (July 1-December 31; 100,545 rows) and 2026 is partial (January 1-June 11; 36,424 rows). No crash dates or times are missing. Use complete years 2013-2025 (2,132,218 rows) and exclude 136,969 rows in the two partial years; after excluding 42 complete-year crashes with a missing casualty count, the final population is 2,132,176 crashes.
data_check.field_quality_and_decisions: In 2013-2025, number_of_persons_injured is NULL for 18 rows (0.000844%) and number_of_persons_killed is NULL for 36 rows (0.001688%); 42 rows (0.001970%) have either outcome missing, including overlap. There are no negative counts. Zero is a valid no-recorded-casualty value (1,608,886 injury zeros and 2,128,911 death zeros); retain them. Exclude the 42 rows with either field missing because casualty status cannot be classified consistently. Retain 23,787 midnight times in night.
data_check.changes: Limit analysis to complete years 2013-2025, use complete cases for both casualty fields, and exclude 42 rows with an unknown outcome.

final_plan.answerability: partly: this estimates how often recorded crashes involve a casualty, conditional on a police-reported crash; it does not estimate risk per trip, person, or mile.
final_plan.metric: share of police-reported crashes with at least one person injured or killed
final_plan.denominator: complete-case police-reported crashes with a usable time and non-missing injury and death counts, in 2013-2025
final_plan.population: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes in complete calendar years 2013-2025 with non-missing number_of_persons_injured and number_of_persons_killed
filters: Exclude rows with NULL injury or death counts
Retain zero counts and classify midnight as night
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; all are complete calendar years in the file
limitations: The metric is conditional on a reported crash and does not account for road-user exposure or unreported crashes.
Recorded casualty counts may not reflect unreported/underreported injuries; midnight values could include source defaults.
